Cam: Heads-up  running a 30m message lab tomorrow 9:00am PT to finalize the battlecard + bench lines for launch. Targets: 2 defensible benchmark callouts, 3 SDR hooks, 1-page rebut cheat. Who can join? :v:
Leila: I'm in. I'll bring P50/P95 traces and a short note on quantization tradeoffs.
Marco: Can do. I'll pull the latency vs ManagedAPI and cloud endpoints for 128/512 token profiles.
Jun: I'll draft the rebut cheat (objection -> 1-line comeback -> 1 supporting datapoint).
Elena: SDR hooks should be <18 words. Propose PLG, AE, and Tech variants for A/B.
Cam: Sample hooks to iterate on:
  PLG: "Ship chat features faster: predictable latency + lower per-interaction spend."
  AE: "SLA-backed inference with private deployments and dedicated capacity."
  Tech: "Runtime batching + KV cache + quant-friendly kernels = lower unit cost without added latency."
Leila: Bench note: our 512-run median ~23ms; comparable cloud-managed median ~95-130ms depending on model. Cost delta varies with batching/quant; will attach CSVs. Avoid absolutes like "always cheaper".
Marco: Can we say "up to 3-4x lower unit cost in our benchmark under typical chat loads" and link appendix? That feels safe if we include configs.
Leila: Yes, "up to" + appendix link. QA must vet raw numbers before public release.
Jun: Inbound routing rule suggestion: if demo request contains /(latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput|predictable)/i -> tag enterprise-sales, else growth-inbound.
Elena: For SDR playtest: 50-email micro-A/B (PLG vs Tech), capture replies mentioning SLA/latency for routing signal.
ops-bot: Calendar invite sent for 09:00-09:30 PT to #marketing. Pre-read link: https://notion.company/redwood/message-lab-8001112223
Cam: Action items: Leila -> upload bench CSV + appendix; Marco -> cleaned benchmark phrasing + slides; Jun -> rebut cheat; Elena -> 3 SDR hooks + A/B plan. We'll lock copy after the lab and hand off to SDR ops Friday.
